encoding.name: producer-typed-frame-c1
encoding.frame: LP(x) = uint64 big-endian UTF-8 byte length followed by x. E(null)=0x6e; E(false)=0x66; E(true)=0x74; E(string)=0x73||LP(UTF8(string)); E(array)=0x61||uint64be(count)||E(each item in order); E(object)=0x6f||uint64be(count)||[E(key)||E(value)] sorted by UTF-8 key bytes. Numeric JSON values are forbidden; counters are canonical unsigned decimal strings bounded to uint64. Reject invalid Unicode, cycles, sparse arrays, non-plain objects and unsupported values. No whitespace, newline or Unicode normalization.
encoding.target_key_note: Profile hash and slots are part of the complete request/admission, but not the logical target key: changing a profile cannot create an unfenced second current run for the same target. Scope is the SQL key prefix.
encoding.result_request_fields: Every ResultRequest field, including nulls and complete sorted results. No omission, coercion, timestamp rounding or caller-selected hash projection.
encoding.command_request_fields: Every CommandRequest field. Acquire/takeover IDs generated by the host BEFORE the first attempt and held stable across retries; commit uncertainty never regenerates them.
encoding.manifest_fields: manifest_hash is SHA256 of existing A systembackupevidence.canonical(Manifest) bytes, not a new C1 manifest serializer: recursively ASCII-key-sorted compact JSON with exact integer decimal numbers, no trailing LF, no omitted/null chunks. Closed identity/key/envelope_hash/object_checksum/object_size_bytes/header_size_bytes/chunk_list_root/chunks include all existing Manifest/Chunk fields from backend/internal/systembackupevidence/types.go. A validates its original Manifest and returns this trusted digest; D rechecks it against the persisted manifest. It has no self-hash field. Request typed framing binds this digest plus original content/object/ref/version/deadlines separately; does not change A encryption/AAD or its canonical JSON.
encoding.parser: Internal typed records only. Any future JSON transport must reject duplicate/unknown/case-variant keys and invalid UTF-8 before decoding; JSON.parse is not an admission parser. Reference codec takes already decoded plain data, not raw network JSON.

private_types.AuthenticatedPrincipal: A-created sealed principal: identity hash, issuer, current revocation record, identity deadline and independently verified host. Never constructed from Scope or IDs.
private_types.ExecutionHandle: D sealed service-local object: committed scope/grant ID/generation/run and subject binding. No JSON, string token or exported field constructor. Contains no provider credential.
private_types.CallSnapshot: D sealed immutable object: handle binding, scenario/admission, domain epoch, grant row version, target generation, subject/host, policy hash, purpose, exact evidence/ref/claim, captured DB now and fixed minimum deadline. Recheck compares the full snapshot to locked current state, not a newly extended policy.
private_types.LockedPrefix: Unexported transaction-bound context: exact *sql.Tx, DB identity, lock plan, highest completed layer, sorted key sets, prelocked identities/refs/holds/capacity report and immutable history. Reuse only in that transaction; cannot authorize a different evidence ID or acquire an earlier layer.
private_types.PublicationClaim: A/D sealed object minted only after committed pending + committed publish claim are confirmed. Tied to evidence row version, run, claim owner/deadline and manifest. No task claim coercion.
private_types.HistoricalAuthority: A-created independent read/recovery authorization with current deployment, scope, exact evidence or receipt scope, allowed Stat operation, deadline and revocation epoch. Not convertible to ExecutionHandle.

lock_layers.objects: all installation index rows/ranges ordered by installation, including empty range
installation/current config or absence range, then producer domain scope key
users/session/revocation or authenticated workload/recovery revocation rows
operation/command/result/GC receipt keys and missing-key ranges, stable type then key order
grants, runs, immutable historical bindings, host identity; stable type then ID; task paths keep task/attempt/Job
target generations, existing projection slots, all legacy/new reference/hold ranges and admin nonce candidates
metadata reservation id=1 when charging; report pinned before transaction
intent audit append; all referenced actor/FK records already locked
evidence public_id order, chunks index order; only update previously locked result/ref/receipt keys afterward
fresh DB UTC check, conditional CAS, repeat UTC check after final write, commit; no new business locks or external I/O

methods.name: Acquire
methods.effect: Lock L0-L10; no config/installation created; verify domain/scenario, CAS target generation, insert grant/run and immutable receipt with capacity/audits. Full target and slots selected by admitted evaluator.

methods.name: Renew
methods.effect: Unexpired original owner, generation and row version CAS. Advance grant version even for same requested expiry. No extension of owner write cutoff/observation. Replay returns original receipt, not a newly renewed handle.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.effect: Current management authority and exact generation/CAS; allow expired grant. Close authority without waiting on evidence or deleting history.

methods.name: Takeover
input: verified old expiry or reviewed termination decision
methods.effect: CAS old target generation; new grant generation/run/evidence and separately admitted authority. Old manifest is never rewritten; old run only eligible for independent recovery.

methods.name: BindObservation
output: immutable observation bound to original run
methods.effect: After the authorized probe and before content preparation, lock L0-L10 and CAS the original acquired run observation pair from both null to authenticated observed_at/expiry. Reject future/out-of-window times using DB UTC and admitted freshness/dependency bounds. Existing exact pair is readback only, not refresh; changed values reject. Pending compares these fixed times to A validated probe content and results; caller timestamps without authenticated evaluator provenance never suffice. This operation grants no evidence claim or successful health result.

methods.name: BeginCall
methods.effect: Fixed deadline=min(DB lease, deployment, subject, dependency, call budget); content_read/wrap/sts/publish additionally require original observation already fixed by BindObservation and its expiry; write also fixed owner cutoff and committed claim. Initial probe may run only while observation is unset and cannot publish or mint evidence STS. No pending claim permits PUT. Probe operation profile/remote ACL is separately reviewed, not the evidence publication ACL.

methods.name: RecheckCall
methods.effect: Before and after content/Wrap/STS/provider call, compare every captured binding to current authority. Renewal invalidates previous version. Never recompute a later deadline.

methods.name: LockAdmission
methods.effect: Reuse verified prefix if already held. Reject absent identities, unknown refs or incomplete keys. Do not open/commit a second transaction.

methods.name: AdmitPending
methods.effect: L7-L9 pending, immutable binding, observation, references, reservation and audits atomic. Same evidence replay compares original bytes with no re-Wrap/no duplicate charge. Caller must FinalGuard then commit.

methods.name: ClaimPublication
methods.effect: Fresh authority and original pending binding; private claim CAS under L0-L10. Ambiguous commit requires same-key readback before claim construction.

methods.name: FinishPublication
methods.effect: Full authority/manifest/claim/CAS check; revoked caller cannot register ready. Provider operation occurs outside transaction. FinalGuard mandatory.

methods.name: CommitResult
methods.effect: Compare request with locked identity/profile/admission/run; L8 ready evidence hash/version/owner/type/retention/GC validation; atomically CAS target and all projection slots, add references/receipt/capacity/audits. Caller commits only after FinalGuard; only confirmed committed receipt is returned.

methods.name: LoadHistoricalBinding
output: immutable binding + restricted exact Stat context
methods.effect: No original config-active requirement. Never returns execution handle or PUT/Range/Delete/Unwrap rights.

methods.name: ClaimRecovery
methods.effect: L0-L10 using history; DB now >= fixed owner write cutoff and previous evidence claim released/expired. New recovery identity may read exact original ref after separate admission.

methods.name: FinishRecovery
methods.effect: Matched object may become ready, ordinary 404 remains unknown with bounded backoff. Cannot write capability/health/observation dates or resume producer. FinalGuard mandatory.

methods.name: ReadReceipt
input: fresh authenticated active execution authority OR HistoricalAuthority
methods.effect: Same-key locking resolves ambiguous commit. No plain snapshot absence decision. Old grant alone insufficient; does not issue an execution handle or refresh time.

methods.name: FinalGuard
methods.effect: After all callbacks/audits/writes: fresh DB UTC, all locked authority/CAS/claims/ref/retention, report age<=5s and not future. Any final conditional write must have exact RowsAffected, then fresh UTC recheck. Rollback on failure. No network/file/audit/new lock after guard.

error_scope: Internal C1 errors only, not additions to public operation/failure enums. No handles or credentials in messages. commit_unknown is not rollback proof; retry_same_request only after confirmed rollback/deadlock.
commit_rule: Authorization linearizes at final successful DB-time guard while locks held, visibility at commit. If local deadline elapsed by commit return, do not issue usable handle/snapshot or new execution success; retain historical receipt. MySQL fsync completion before deadline is not promised.

existing_entry_changes.change: Lock domain and candidate history/references with same prefix, consume reviewed candidates and close epoch atomically with disabled-v1 config/receipt; no unbounded child-grant update.
PersistPending/WithLocked transaction owner must invoke FinalGuard after all callbacks/chunks/audits; OwnerDeadline only reads prelocked historical binding. SQLPolicy alone cannot commit-guard.
Acquire GC operation at L3 before L4-L6; lock every reference range at L5 before evidence; use shared transaction prefix.
Split pinned report load, reservation lock and charge. Recheck pinned report after waits and at final guard; no fresh file read at L10.
Add independently authorized historical system branch without active-config requirement; preserve evidence-only recovery and final time guards.

acceptance: V01-V10 in producer-authority-vectors.json; static vectors are not runtime evidence. Real MySQL schema/FK/gap/audit/commit waits, A adapters, C providers and optional B host still required.
